intro.zh: 银行家蒙冤入狱，用近二十年时间与希望凿穿高墙；关于耐心与自由的经典。
intro.en: A banker, wrongly convicted, spends nearly twenty years turning patience and hope into freedom.

intro.zh: 单纯的人在历史洪流里一路奔跑，意外见证半个世纪的美国；温情而轻盈。
intro.en: A simple man runs through half a century of American history, seeing more than he ever sought.

intro.zh: 巨轮航首的短暂相遇，在灾难中凝成一句承诺；跨越阶层的爱情史诗。
intro.en: A brief meeting at the bow of a great ship becomes a lifelong promise amid catastrophe.

intro.zh: 潜入他人梦境的层层结构，现实与记忆的边界逐渐溶解；一场精密的视觉迷宫。
intro.en: A thief who steals secrets from dreams takes one last job, and the layers of reality begin to blur.

intro.zh: 穿越虫洞为人类寻找新家园，亲情在时空扭曲中被拉长；科学与情感的双重远征。
intro.en: A father travels through a wormhole to find humanity a new home, while time stretches his bond with his daughter.

intro.zh: 一个人的整个生活竟是直播节目；当天空出现裂缝，他决定走出去；关于真实与自由的寓言。
intro.en: A man discovers his whole life is a television show, and walks toward the edge of his painted sky.

intro.zh: 家族权力与亲情的代价，在两代接班中缓缓展开；黑帮史诗的巅峰。
intro.en: A crime family passes power from father to son, at the cost of loyalty, love, and innocence.

intro.zh: 落魄推销员带着儿子在困境中坚持，最终叩开幸福之门；关于韧性的真实故事。
intro.en: A struggling salesman and his son endure homelessness until persistence opens the door to a better life.

intro.zh: 兔子警官与狐狸搭档协作破案，在偏见中重新理解彼此；明亮幽默的成人童话。
intro.en: A rabbit officer and a fox con artist team up to solve a case, learning to see past their stereotypes.

intro.zh: 热爱音乐的男孩误入亡灵世界，在寻祖途中读懂家族与记忆；绚烂而催泪。
intro.en: A boy who loves music wanders into the Land of the Dead and discovers the story behind his family.
